requirement.statement: An IndexedDB revisioned VFS authority SHALL durably retain one authority-qualified snapshot and live revision, and SHALL linearize freshness validation, semantic no-op detection, and accepted snapshot/revision replacement in one browser-storage transaction.

case.given: An authority has accepted and durably stored a snapshot revision.
case.when: A new authority instance opens the same database and authority identity.
case.then: It SHALL restore the exact snapshot and revision and SHALL NOT overwrite them with its initial seed.

case.given: Two independently opened authority instances submit different candidates from the same current revision.
case.then: Exactly one SHALL return applied with workspace durability, the other SHALL return conflict, and reopen SHALL expose the winning snapshot and revision.

case.given: An IndexedDB transaction aborts or fails before durable completion.
case.when: The authority returns a failed result and is reopened.
case.then: The previous snapshot and revision SHALL remain authoritative and a retry from that revision MAY succeed.

case.given: A browser consumer imports the explicit xnl-vfs/revisioned-persistence subpath.
case.when: It creates the IndexedDB authority through the public factory.
case.then: The subpath's reachable implementation SHALL use no Node-only builtins and SHALL preserve the existing RevisionedVfsAuthority and VCS-separation contracts without making a new browser-safety claim for the package root.
